judgement.reason: Langflow is one HTTP app on PostgreSQL, and its Celery/RabbitMQ stack is an optional deploy add-on, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is not too lenient.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares result_backend (redis:6.2.5) in deploy/docker-compose.yml; broker (rabbitmq:3-management) in deploy/docker-compose.yml; BROKER_URL in deploy/.env.example. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The shown lines do not prove that the RabbitMQ broker and the Redis result backend are optional, and the Celery worker and Flower commands need a broker URL, so the finding stays for you to confirm.
